title: USA: New York and Boston metros
description: Coverage-gap section 2026-10-13: indoor bouldering gyms in the New York metro (NYC, Long Island, Westchester, lower Hudson Valley, north/central NJ commuter belt, Fairfield and New Haven counties CT) and Greater Boston (MA, to about 40 km) plus Providence RI. Bounding box section: NJ and CT parts overlap the earlier 2026-10-06-us-northeast section, so existing gyms are same-as.
